feedback.onset: only after nominal ramp completes; no feedback during initial hold/ramp
feedback.channels: left arm12 plus assigned finger4 only; other fingers and partner unchanged
feedback.antiwindup: store only offset surviving both0.1rad cap and existing action target bounds
feedback.application: bounded39 action inverse only; no controller target/DOF overwrite; native control/PD unchanged

settings.interpretation: Same finite prepared-frame q trajectory; free failure alone does not prove a policy/controller defect
settings.after_failure: Row outcomes/captures censored at first safety failure; no reset or state injection; bounded hold while other isolated rows finish
settings.contact_scope: Current assigned distal pad geometry + net distal body load + original wrong veto; no contact pair/pressure/acoustic success

guitar_representation.proxy_collision_policy: G:thumb_support_proxy and G:pluck_range retain visuals and their original mass/COM/inertia contribution, but both geoms have contype=conaffinity=0. Intentional difference: their original possible chair/ground contacts are fully excluded. Original logical39 markers and source properties retained.

scene.state_setter_scope: Episode boundaries only; human DOF and free guitar root

hand_collision.external_pair_preservation: Checked against actual compound-guitar and chair filters; the two source guitar proxies have no physical shape in the GPU compound asset.

source_fk_readback.limitation: Source candidate interpretation must account for actual native/source FK discrepancies; calibration alone is not a perturbation proof
